stage1.impression: A strong mood: a backlit smoky forest cut into shafts, with the dark speaker on the left third and tree-shadow stripes running toward the lens. It still reads as CG. The trunks are smooth, smeared cylinders with no pine-bark plates, the ground is a soft, denoised leaf smear with no micro-detail, and the smoke is a flat beige wall with no wisps. The speaker is a near-black block with only a faint rim, its tint and amber glow mostly lost, and it casts no shadow along the sun shafts the way the trees do.

blocking_9: Pine trunks show deep, plated bark at real scale, with no smeared or brushed look (right trunk 990-1130 x 150-480 needs visible plate edges and crevices)
The forest floor reads as pine needles, cones and duff with crisp micro-detail at the speaker's feet, not a blurred leaf texture
The smoke has visible structure (wisps, density variation, layering), not a flat gradient: open-sky smoke on the left must have lum_range > 45
The speaker is rimmed in warm light on both vertical edges and its smoked tint glows amber where the sun passes through, while it still reads as a dark silhouette
The speaker casts a long, soft shadow toward the camera-left along the sun shafts, consistent with the trees' shadows
No denoiser smearing at full resolution (final at 2400 x 1600 with enough samples)

defects.what: Near trunk at the right: smooth, streaky, denoiser-smeared bark with no plate relief; reads as a CG cylinder
Centre trunk: same smooth, untextured bark; perfectly regular taper
Near-left trunk: soft, featureless bark, no depth-of-field cue that it is closer
Ground: soft, smeared leaf texture with no crisp needles, cones or twigs; looks low-resolution and denoised
Smoke is a flat, featureless wall (lum_range 20.7, monotone falloff); no wisps or layering
Cabinet reads as a flat near-black block (lum_median 31); the amber tint and through-light hardly show
Left vertical edge has almost no rim (median 31); only the right edge picks up light from the background
No shadow from the speaker on the ground, although the trees cast long shadows toward camera-left; the speaker looks pasted in
Waveguide interior crushes to black (crush 8.3 %) in the middle of the frame's brightest area
The whole frame is one sepia tone; no cool counterpoint in the shadows, so depth reads only through haze

changes.problem: Trunks read as smooth CG cylinders: the bark has no plates or crevices at real scale.

evidence.measured: Crop at 2x shows streaky, smeared tone with no plate edges; the large trunk's texture variance comes from shading, not bark.

change.from: 1.6 m a tile, tinted 15 %, true displacement 0.025 m within 6 m, bump 5 beyond
change.to: 0.7 m a tile (plates of about 8-15 cm), true displacement 0.05 m on every trunk within 14 m, roughness map driven by the bark AO (crevices 0.95, plate faces 0.75), a second lichen/char layer on the lower 1.5 m

changes.expected: Plates and dark crevices visible on the right and centre trunks, rim-lit on the sun side; trunks stop reading as cylinders.

changes.problem: The speaker casts no visible shadow along the sun shafts, so it does not sit in the same light as the trees.

evidence.measured: Ground front-left of the speaker lum_median 116.6, as bright as the open lit stripe at 120-320 x 520-560 (148) less the vignette; no darker lane leading from the base.

change.from: speaker at the origin in a shadow lane; sun azimuth 150, elevation 16
change.to: move the speaker about 0.6 m sideways into a lit sun shaft (or turn the sun to azimuth 145) so its own long shadow falls toward camera-left across the lit ground; keep the sun at elevation 16

changes.expected: A soft, dark shadow lane 3-4 cabinet widths long leading from the base toward the lower left, at least 35 % darker than the lit ground beside it; a bright sunlit strip of ground directly behind the speaker separating its base from the floor.

changes.problem: The silhouette is only half-rimmed: the left edge is dark and the smoked tint barely glows.

evidence.measured: Left edge strip lum_median 31.3, the same as the cabinet face (30.8); edge step on the left -63 against -204 on the right.

change.to: 0.3 x 3.0 m, elevation 12, irradiance 140, moved so it grazes the left vertical edge and the top of the horn; and raise the through-light from irradiance 8 to 18 so the amber tint glows through the lower side panels

changes.expected: A continuous warm hairline on the left edge of the cabinet; the cabinet face lifts slightly to an amber-brown and still reads dark against the glow.

changes.problem: The smoke is a flat, uniform beige wall, so it reads as fog in a render rather than drifting woodsmoke.

evidence.measured: lum_range 20.7, p5 188 to p95 209; the y-profile rises monotonically 190.6 -> 207 with no breakup.

change.from: density 0.10, noise scale 3.0 m, cut 0.5, soft 0.15
change.to: two octaves: scale 3.0 m plus a detail octave at 0.6 m (weight 0.35), cut 0.55, soft 0.08, density 0.12, with a slight upward-stretched noise (z scale x2) so it reads as rising wisps; add one thin drifting band crossing in front of the far trunks at 2-3 m height

changes.expected: Visible wisps and density variation in the glow; light shafts break across the smoke instead of a smooth gradient.

changes.problem: The forest floor is a soft, smeared leaf texture with no crisp needles, cones or twigs, and it reads as low resolution.

evidence.measured: Crop at 2x shows blurred, blotchy leaves; no individual element is sharper than about 3 px at the focal plane.

change.from: forest_leaves_04 tinted 30 % toward #4A3626, 40 x 40 m, displacement 0.06 m
change.to: a pine-needle/duff floor texture (e.g. forest floor with needles) at 2 m a tile, with a scatter of modelled cones, needle clumps and small twigs (about 200 instances within 4 m of the speaker, a few touching its base)

changes.expected: Crisp needles and cones in focus at the speaker's feet, falling off into bokeh toward the foreground; ground texture variance rises.

changes.problem: The denoiser smears fine bark and ground detail, which reads as 'render'.

evidence.measured: Crop shows brushed, painterly streaks on the trunk typical of denoising at low samples.

change.to: full 2400 x 1600, 1024 samples, denoiser with albedo+normal passes at reduced strength; add 0.8 % fine film grain in the finish

changes.expected: Bark and needle detail stays crisp; grain unifies product and set.

changes.problem: The frame is monochrome sepia with no cool counterpoint, so shadow areas lack depth and the smoke has nothing to glow against.

evidence.measured: Foreground shadow r 85 / g 57 / b 35; blue is 41 % of red, as warm as the sunlit smoke.

change.to: irradiance 7.0, #8FA4C4, and raise the sky strength from 0.08 to 0.14 so open shade on the ground goes slightly cool

changes.expected: Shadow lanes on the ground turn neutral to slightly cool, against warm sunlit stripes and smoke: clearer depth and a more photographic split.

changes.problem: The centre trunk at x 620-750 sits just right of the speaker and competes with it for the bright gap.

evidence.measured: Trunk lum_median 124 against the glow at 560-700 x 150-330 (225): a strong dark vertical one cabinet-width from the product.

change.from: trunk about 6-8 m back at frame centre
change.to: move it 1.5 m to the right (or 4 m further back into the smoke) so the speaker has an open, glowing gap on both sides

changes.expected: The speaker is the only strong dark vertical in the left half; clean room for type in the glow to its right.

out_of_scope.request: Lighten or warm the smoked acrylic itself so the cabinet reads less black
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour is fixed; handled instead with the through-light and kicker (c3).

out_of_scope.request: The waveguide's dark interior crushes to black in the brightest part of the frame
out_of_scope.why: The waveguide's shape and finish are part of the speaker; only light on it may change.
